LanguageData.Utilities_drawFixturesDesc: When disabled, ceiling-mounted lights and firefoam poppers are hidden from view. They keep working normally.
LanguageData.Utilities_useDrawFixturesToggleDesc: Adds a button to the bottom-right toolbar to quickly show or hide ceiling fixtures.
